name: Kyonyuu Shimai Kyoushi ~In'yoku no Hitozuma Choukyou~
original_name: 巨乳姉妹教師 ～淫欲の人妻調教～
source:
The main character is a school director who enjoys insulting women. When a new married female teacher comes to school, he develops a humiliation plan for this teacher and her sister with the help of the nurse. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名以羞辱女性为乐的校董。学校新来了一位已婚女教师后，他在校医协助下，拟定了一个羞辱这位教师及其姐妹的计划。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
